finalText:
Migrated the last 12 stragglers over to `db.execute({ sql, params })` — one file in each of analytics, orders (×2), billing (×2), support (×2), catalog (×2), and accounts (×2). Left `cache.query` and the vendored `legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone since those aren't part of the swap.

`node verify.js` confirms it: no `db.query` left in app code, every `execute` call carries `sql` and `params`, and every module still loads and runs.
